drawn.choice: Let an outside AI model describe these photos and read any text in them
drawn.label: Let an outside AI model describe these photos and read any text in them
drawn.notice: A copy of each selected photo, reduced in size if it is large and without its location or camera details, will be sent to an AI service outside Exulanica, at api.tokenfactory.nebius.com, where a model will describe what it shows and read any text in it. The people in the photo are not hidden from this model: it is the model that finds them, so that Exulanica can hide them in what it builds. The model is MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3, or when that one is unavailable, openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5. You can stop this at any time: nothing more is sent from then on, and descriptions already made stay in your library.

drawn.label: Let an outside AI model index these photos' descriptions so your questions can find them
drawn.notice: The descriptions made from each selected photo will be sent to an AI service outside Exulanica, at api.tokenfactory.nebius.com, where a model will index them so your questions can find the photo. Names you gave people are replaced before anything is sent, and a place's name is sent only where you allowed it for that place. The model is Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B. You can stop this at any time: nothing more is sent from then on, and search entries already made stay.

steps.reason: No control in the application produces scene geometry from admitted photographs. Multi-view reconstruction runs as a scheduled job on GPU compute outside this runtime, and a photograph's point map is placed only through the World API; both also need a person's review of each photograph, which a rehearsal cannot truthfully give.
A person's use of the experience and the demonstration footage are observed and recorded by a person; this rehearsal keeps a screenshot of each step as its own record.

what_this_does_not_show: The world is the authored starter of a synthetic workspace, and the photographs are synthetic drawings; no personal photograph or reconstructed place is involved.
The proposed place was confirmed through the identity routes rather than in the application.
Stopping a right in the drawer was not exercised by this run.
One run: the Companion's answers vary between runs.
Access used the production build's operator token gate; account sign-in was not exercised.
No person observed the run and no demonstration footage was recorded; no frame time was measured.
Other work loaded the machine during the run (machine_load, from the GPU slot's own log lines); the times are not timing measurements.
